# Machine: Apple M4 Max (Mac16,6)
# macOS: 26.4.1 (25E253)
# Go: go1.26.2
# Swift: release (SwiftUIBridge, rebuilt from internal/swift with P7 α+β+α-follow-up integrated)
#
# Non-animated benches (match baseline runner):
#   go test -run=nothing -bench='^Benchmark(IntStateSetSame|IntStateSetChanging|BoolStateSetSame|FloatStateSetSame|DateStateSetSame|StringStateSetSame|StateGenReadHot|StateGenReadMiss|CallbackDispatch|CallbackDispatchParallel|BoolCallbackDispatch|StringCallbackDispatch|LeafText|LeafSpacer|LeafImage|ContainerBuild|ContainerBuildReuse|ContainerBuildNoReuse|ModifierChain)$' -benchmem -count=10 -benchtime=2s .
#
# Animated + Coalesce benches (new; shorter benchtime to cap pending-writes retention):
#   go test -run=nothing -bench='^Benchmark(AnimatedStateSetSerial|AnimatedStateSetParallel|AnimatedStateSetInline|CoalesceUpperBound|CoalesceRatio)$' -benchmem -count=10 -benchtime=500ms .
#
# Rationale for split runs: the new Animated/Coalesce benches route Set
# calls through the Swift-side BridgeCommandQueue enqueue path. Go's
# test harness does not drive the main-thread runloop, so the Swift
# queue's pending-writes map accumulates across the whole bench run.
# At -benchtime=2s × 10 × many sub-benchmarks, the retained-closure
# footprint crosses available memory; -benchtime=500ms keeps it
# bounded while still delivering ≥10 samples per sub-benchmark.
#
# Post-P7: animated-state setters route through BridgeCommandQueue
# (α primitive, β integration, α follow-up @_cdecl C-ABI counter
# accessors). Off-main callers enqueue with a single armed flush per
# frame; main-thread callers apply inline inside withAnimation. New
# AnimatedState* and Coalesce* benches report coalescedWrites and
# mainHops counters via SwiftUIDebug.Stats() for the charter §5 exit
# #3 ratio gate. Non-animated benches (IntStateSetSame,
# CallbackDispatch*, LeafText, ModifierChain, etc.) must match the
# bench-p7-before.txt baseline within noise (charter §5 exit #4).
#
# Note: Go bench harness runs off the main OS thread, so mainHops
# stays zero within a bench window and the coalesceRatio metric is
# reported as NaN (unreported). The flagship-example counter reading
# is the ground-truth ratio; see P7.γ summary.
#
goos: darwin
goarch: arm64
pkg: github.com/tmc/swiftui
cpu: Apple M4 Max
